book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Gbɑɑ wuko kɔ̃sobun ɡɑri

Yen biru, Yesu u kɑ bu mɔndu ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, durɔ ɡoo u ɡbɑɑru kuɑ mi u dɑ̃ɑ bii duronu duurɑ ni bɑ rɑ soku resɛm, mɑ u kɑrɑ kuɑ u kɑ sikerenɑ. U mɑɑ wɔru ɡbɑ mi bɑ koo dɑ̃ɑ bii ni ɡɑmɑ mɑ u ɡbɑɑ kɔ̃su yeru kuɑ. Yerɑ u ɡbɑɑ wukobu kɑsu u bu ye nɔmu bɛriɑ mɑ u wiɡiru doonɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ dɑ̃ɑ binun sɔribu turɑ, u win sɔm kowo ɡɔrɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko ben mi bu win bɔnu mwɑɑmɑ.
Yerɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko be, bɑ sɔm kowo wi mwɑ bɑ so mɑ bɑ nùn ɡɔsiɑ nɔm dirɑ.
Yerɑ u kpɑm bu sɔm kowo ɡoo ɡɔriɑ mɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko be, bɑ nùn so wirɔ mɑ bɑ nùn yɑɑ kɑsiki.
Gbɑɑ yɛ̃ro wi, u kpɑm mɑɑ bu sɔm kowo ɡɔriɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn ɡo. Mɛyɑ bɑ ben dɑbinu kuɑ, bɑ ɡɑbu so bɑ ɡɑbu ɡo.
Tɛ̃, n tie ɡbɑɑ yɛ̃ro win bii kĩnɑsin tii tii. Wiyɑ u bu ɡɔriɑ dɑ̃kuru u nɛɛ, bɑ koo win biin nɔnu nɑsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ ɡbɑɑ wuko be, bɑ wesiɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, winiwɑ ɡbɑɑ ten tubi dio. I nɑ su nùn ɡo kpɑ ɡbɑɑ te, tu ko bɛsɛɡiru.
Yerɑ bɑ ɑluwɑɑsi wi mwɑ bɑ ɡo. Mɑ bɑ win ɡoru yɑrɑ ɡbɑɑrun di.
Yesu u nɛɛ, tɛ̃, ɑmɔnɑ ɡbɑɑ yɛ̃ro wi, u koo ko. U koo dɑ u ɡbɑɑ wuko be ɡo kpɑ u win ɡbɑɑru ɡɑbu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Bɛɛ i ǹ ɡɑri yini ɡɑrɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ yi yi nɛɛ,

content.text: “Kpee te bɑnɔbɑ yinɑ, terɑ tɑ kuɑ ɡɑni ɡɔmburun dɑm.
Yinniwɑ ye kuɑ, mɑ n kuɑ mɑɑmɑɑki bɛsɛn nɔni sɔɔ.”

content: Yerɑ bɑ swɑɑ kɑsu bu kɑ nùn mwɑ, domi bɑ tubɑ mɑ ben sɔ̃nɑ u mɔn te kuɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ tɔn wɔru nɑsiɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn deri bɑ doonɑ.
Wɔ̃ɔ ɡobin kɔsiɑbun ɡɑri
Mɑ bɑ Fɑlisi ɡɑbu kɑ Herodun tɔmbu ɡɑbu ɡɔrɑ Yesun mi, bu kɑ nùn ɡɑrin yinɑ bɛriɑ.

Ye bɑ turɑ win mi, bɑ nɛɛ, yinni, sɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɑ rɑ ɡem ɡere. Mɛyɑ ɑ ku rɑ ɡoon nɔnu mɛɛri, domi ɑ ku rɑ ɡɑri ɡere binɛ kɑ bɛrum sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ tɔmbu Gusunɔn swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔwɑ dee dee. N weenɛ su tem yɛ̃ro wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɔsiɑ? Nɡe su ku kɔsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u ben murɑfiti te tubɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kɑ mɑn ɡɑrin yinɑ bɛriɑmmɛ. I mɑn sii ɡeesun ɡobi sɔ̃ɔsimɑ n wɑ.
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔsi. Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, weren foto kɑ yĩrerɑ mini. Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, tem yɛ̃roɡiɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i tem yɛ̃ro kɔsio ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ tem yɛ̃roɡiɑ kpɑ i mɑɑ Gusunɔ kɔsiɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔɡiɑ. Yerɑ biti bɑkɑ bu mwɑ n bɑndɑ win sɔ̃.
Gɔribun seebun ɡɑri
Yerɑ Sɑdusi be bɑ rɑ nɛɛ, ɡɔribɑ kun seemɔ, bɑ dɑ Yesun mi, bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
yinni, Mɔwisi u sun woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, ɡoo ù n ɡu mɑ u kurɔ deri, mɑ wi kɑ kurɔ wi, bɑ ǹ bii mɔ, n weenɛ yɛ̃ro win wɔnɔ u kurɔ ɡɔmini wi suɑ, kpɑ u kɑ mɔɔ bibu mɑruɑ.
Wee, tundo turosibu nɔɔbɑ yiru ɡɑbɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Ben ɡbiikoo u kurɔ suɑ mɑ u ɡu, u ǹ kɑ kurɔ wi bii mɑrɑ.
Yerɑ ben yiruse u kurɔ ɡɔmini wi suɑ. Win tii mɑɑ ɡu, u ǹ kɑ kurɔ wi bii mɑrɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ ben itɑsen tii,
sere n kɑ ɡirɑri ben nɔɔbɑ yiruse, bɑ ǹ kɑ kurɔ wi bii mɑrɑ. Be kpuron biruwɑ kurɔ win tii mɑɑ ɡu.
Dɔmɑ te ɡɔribɑ koo se, tɔn ben wɑrɑ ko n kurɔ wi mɔ. Domi be nɔɔbɑ yiru ye kpuro bɑ nùn yɛ̃wɑ kurɔ.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i ǹ Gusunɔn ɡɑri kɑ win dɑm yɛ̃. N ǹ yen sɔ̃nɑ i tore?
Domi sɑnɑm mɛ ɡɔribɑ koo se durɔbu kɑ kurɔbu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ suɑnɑmɔ, bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ.
Ye n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun seebun ɡɑri, i ǹ ɡɑrire Mɔwisin tireru sɔɔ mi ɑwĩi dɔ̃ɔɡiin ɡɑri wɑ̃ɑ nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u kɑ nùn ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ, “Wiyɑ Aburɑhɑmun Yinni, kɑ Isɑkin Yinni, kɑ Yɑkɔbun Yinni.”
Wee, Gusunɔ u ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔribun Yinni. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑsobuɡii. Yenin sɔ̃nɑ bɛɛn torɑrɑ kpɑ̃.
Woodɑ ye yɑ bo
N wee, woodɑ yɛ̃ro ɡoo u ben sikirinɔ ɡe nuɑ. U wɑ mɑ Yesu u Sɑdusi be ɡɑri ɡee wisɑ, mɑ u dɑ Yesun mi u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, woodɑbɑ kpuro sɔɔ yerɑ̀ yɑ kere.
Yesu u nɛɛ, woodɑ ye yɑ kere wee. “Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, i swɑɑ dɑkio, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, wi turowɑ Yinni.
A Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni kĩɔ kɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro kɑ wunɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kpuro kɑ wunɛn bwisikunu kpuro kɑ wunɛn dɑm kpuro.”
Yen yiruse wee. “A wunɛn tɔnusi kĩɔ nɡe wunɛn tii tii.” Woodɑ ɡɑɑ mɑɑ sɑri ye yɑ yeni kere.
Mɑ woodɑ yɛ̃ro wi, u Yesu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, to, n wɑ̃ yinni. Gemɑ ɑ ɡeruɑ ye ɑ nɛɛ Gusunɔ turowɑ wɑ̃ɑ, ɡoo mɑɑ sɑri mɑ n kun mɔ wi.
Mɑ tɔnu ù n Gusunɔ kĩɑ kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kpuro kɑ win bwisikunu kpuro kɑ win dɑm kpuro, ù n mɑɑ win tɔnusi kĩɑ nɡe win tii tii, yeyɑ yɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kɑ yɑ̃ku ni nu tie kere.
Ye Yesu u wɑ mɑ u yeni ɡeruɑwɑ kɑ yɛ̃run bɑɑ, yerɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ turuku koomɑ ɑ kɑ du mi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi. Yenin biru ɡoo kun mɑɑ kɑ̃kɑ u Yesu ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu bikie.
Dɑfidi kɑ wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ
Yen biru, nɡe mɛ Yesu u Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, u tɔmbu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robɑ koo kpĩ bu ɡere mɑ Kirisi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Dɑfidin bii.
Dɑfidin tii, kɑ Hunde Dɛɛron sɔ̃ɔsiru u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛn Yinni sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
sere n kɑ nun wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ tɑɑreɑ.”

content: Dɑfidin tii u nùn sokɑ Yinni. Amɔnɑ u ko n mɑɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ win bii. I tii lɑɑkɑri koowo kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu (I mɑɑ mɛɛrio Mɑteu 23:1-36, Luku 20:45-47) Mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡe, ɡɑ Yesun ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki kɑ nuku dobu.
Win keu sɔ̃ɔsibu sɔɔ u nɛɛ, i tii lɑɑkɑri koowo kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu be bɑ kĩ bɑ n bɔsu kɑ yɑbe dɛndɛnnu, bɑ mɑɑ tɔbirinɑɑ kĩ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ kɑ bɛɛrɛ.
Mɑ bɑ sin yee bɛɛrɛɡinu kĩ mɛnnɔ yenɔ kɑ mɑɑ ɑye bɛɛrɛɡinu tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ yerɔ.
Bɑ ɡɔminibun yɛnusu dimɔ kɑ tɑki mɑ bɑ kɑnɑ dɛndɛnnu mɔ̀ bu kɑ bu wɑn sɔ̃. Bɑ koo bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ n kpɑ̃.
Gobi yi kurɔ ɡɔmini ɡoo u kpɛ̃ɛ
Yerɑ Yesu u dɑ u sinɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kpɑkoro te bɑ rɑ ɡobi doken bɔkuɔ, mɑ u mɛɛrɑ nɡe mɛ tɔmbɑ ɡobi kpɛ̃ɛmɔ te sɔɔ. Gobiɡibu dɑbiru bɑ ɡobi bɛkɛ doke.
Yerɑ ɡɔmini sɑ̃ɑro ɡoo u nɑ mɑ u ɡobi piiminu yiru doke mi, yìn ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe fɑrɑm yirun sɑkɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sokɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡɔmini sɑ̃ɑro wini, u ɡobi doke kpɑkoro teni sɔɔ n tɔmbu kpuro kere.
Domi be kpuro, ye n sɔndi ben mɔɔ bɑkɑru sɔɔ, yerɑ bɑ wunɑ bɑ doke, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wi, win yɑ̃ɑru sɔɔrɑ u kpuro kpɛ̃ɛ ye u kɑ tii kɔ̃su.
